name: Oracle Advertising

optOut.notes: Shut down: Oracle's EOL FAQ (v3.0, Aug 12 2024) says Oracle will End-of-Life all Oracle Advertising products and support effective September 30, 2024. The old advertising privacy policy URL now redirects to oracle.com/contracts/data-services/. Nothing left to opt out of.
